column1: # OWASP ZAP alert rule config for the DAST API scan (.github/workflows/ci-dast.yml).
# The scan targets the FastAPI app directly (uvicorn), WITHOUT the production
# Traefik reverse proxy in front. The app deliberately does not emit response
# security headers itself — Traefik's `security-headers` middleware injects the
# whole suite in the production stack (infra/docker/docker-compose.yml:
# So the "header not set" passive alerts below are false positives for THIS
# test topology (proxy absent), not real gaps. Downgrade them to IGNORE to keep
# the report focused on app-layer findings (injection, auth, info leaks). To
# exercise the header suite dynamically, scan the Traefik-fronted stack — see
# the follow-up note in the workflow header.
# Everything not listed keeps its default threshold (passive alerts WARN; the
# scan is non-gating regardless — see the `-I` flag / continue-on-error step).
